faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) for filling up vacant posts on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IGNCA?
faq.answer: IGNCA has advertised for the post of Consultant (Senior Engineer) under advertisement number 12/363/2026-/SD/AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Senior Engineer) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation in Civil Engineering along with at least 20 years of experience and must have retired from CPWD/CWD/MES/NDMC/State Govt./Autonomous Bodies as Superintending/Executive/Senior Engineer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IGNCA Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Consultant (Senior Engineer) post is not exceeding 62 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Consultant (Senior Engineer) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 70,000/- per month, which is negotiable based on work experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IGNCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates need to fill out the application form and send it through the proper channel to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form along with required documents is 28-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant (Senior Engineer) post comprises screening of applications followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application should be sent to: Deputy Secretary (Administration), INDIRA GANDHI NATIONAL CENTRE FOR THE ARTS, JANPATH, NEW DELHI-110 001.
